insurers.contracting_notes: Primary BH/SUD carve-out for UnitedHealthcare. Facilities often need this contract separately from UHC medical to be in-network for behavioral benefits.
Choice POS II and Open Choice PPO are broad national staples. APCN/APCN+ are performance/ACO overlays. Meritain uses Aetna networks with distinct admin.

plan_types.label: Premier Care Network / APCN+
plan_types.notes: Overlay on Choice POS II / Open Access Select

insurers.contracting_notes: OAP is broad national; LocalPlus is narrower and may need explicit participation. Medicare Advantage largely moved to HealthSpring (HCSC). BH via Evernorth Behavioral Health.

insurers.contracting_notes: MBHO for Cigna commercial and affiliated products. Often separate from Cigna medical contract for BH/SUD facilities.

plan_types.label: Medicare Advantage BH (legacy / HealthSpring coordination)
plan_types.notes: Confirm HealthSpring vs Evernorth role on card

insurers.contracting_notes: Former Cigna Medicare Advantage book; now under HCSC/HealthSpring. Verify entity on member ID.
Also operates as BCBS licensee in multiple states. Contract with local Anthem/affiliate market. BH often via Carelon Behavioral Health.
Formerly Beacon Health Options. Manages Anthem/Elevance BH and many other plan sponsors including Medicaid carve-outs. Often separate contract from medical Anthem.

Medicare Advantage is core book; HMO vs PPO often separate network flags. Medicaid via Healthy Horizons requires state Medicaid enrollment + Humana contract. TRICARE East via Humana Military (see tricare).
Closed integrated HMO model by region. Community facility contracts are specialty/overflow/BH — not broad national PPO. Contract with regional KP entity.
Parent of Ambetter (ACA), Wellcare (Medicare), Health Net, and many state Medicaid brands. Contract with the brand/legal entity on the ID card.

plan_types.label: State Medicaid MCO (local brand)
plan_types.notes: State overlay required — Sunshine, Buckeye, Meridian, Superior, etc.

insurers.contracting_notes: Centene's ACA Marketplace brand. Network tiers: Premier (broader), Select (exclusive), Value (PCP/referral).
Centene Medicare brand (MA and Part D).
Strong California footprint: commercial, Covered California (Ambetter from Health Net), Medicare, Medi-Cal.
Primarily Medicaid/MA/Marketplace HMO by state entity. Out-of-network rare except emergencies.
Distinct MBHO with Medicaid/government strength and FEHB products. Portal/credentialing separate from Centene medical brands. Update parent after Madison close.
insurers.parent: Centene (sale to Madison Health Group announced Feb 2026 — pending)
